在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

很幸运，多亏了[Root.GetLeaderName]的快速行动，激光在造成任何损失之前被无效化了。项目进度向前推进，超出了预期。
texts.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

Fortunately, thanks to the quick actions of [Root.GetLeaderName] the lasers were disabled before they could cause any harm. The project is moving forwards, ahead of schedule.
